caseName: New Orleans Great Northern Railroad v. Mississippi Railroad Commission
caseNameFull: New Orleans Great Northern Railroad Company v. The Mississippi Railroad Commission
attorneys: Mr. Marcellus Green for appellant. Mr. R. V. Fletcher and Mr. C. H. Alexander for appellees.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Circuit Court of the United States for' the Southern District of Mississippi.

Décree reversed at the cost of appellant on confession of error, and cause remanded to be proceeded in according to law, on motion of Mr. Marcellus Green for the appellant.
